notes.title: Update v2.0.0
notes.content:
This is our first major update since release!

Welcome to all of the new players who have joined us over the past month as we transitioned away from the old free-to-play model. We are looking forward to providing you with more content to enjoy.

On to the patch notes!

New Stuff
A new co-op playlist has been added: Chippingrounds
Currently this playlist only has one gametype: Survival
In this mode, players fight waves of monsters with a shared pool of lives. Defeating all of the waves with at least one player left alive will result in victory. If all players are killed and all lives have been consumed or time runs out before all of the enemy waves are cleared, the match will end in defeat
A new PvP playlist has been added: Big Team (8v8)
Added an announcer that voices many different events in the game such as obtaining medals, announcing gametypes, time left, etc.
Added a 'copy to clipboard' button for social links on the Title screen
Added a red vignette effect when you are below 100% health
There is now a Weekly Challenge to complete each week that will give a large amount of Chips as a reward
New Daily Challenges have been added for the new co-op mode Chippingrounds
A 'continue' button has been added to the end of a match that will place you back in to the match lobby if you desire to play another match
Each server button displayed on Title screen will now show your latency to that server without needing to connect to it first
Added more multi-kill medals:
Chiptacular - 6 consecutive kills
Chiptrocity - 7 consecutive kills
Chiptastrophe - 8 consecutive kills
Chipocalypse - 9 consecutive kills
Added more killing spree medals:
Chipping Rampage - 20 kills without dying
Chipping Fury - 25 kills without dying
Chipping Storm - 30 kills without dying
Chipping Madness - 35 kills without dying
New Medal: Hero's Duty - Clear a chippinground round as the only player alive with 0 lives left
New Medal: Watch Your Step - Become the last player alive in a chippinground match with 0 lives left
The match time has been added to the match results screen
Some basic localization has been added to important text throughout the game to help those who have trouble understanding english. The following languages are supported:
English
Spanish
Portuguese
Chinese
Japanese
A new 'sightline' has been added to the Sword and Sniper weapons when charging them that shows you exactly where your weapon will fire
An outline has been added to player characters and pets to make them stand out a bit more
The new outline around players will turn red if that player is not on your team during a match, making your targets easier to distinguish from your own team
The new outline will turn blue for players that are in your group, unless they are on the opposite team in a match
The social lobby has been updated with new buildings that players can enter and explore
Added a Software Cursor toggle in the settings menu (this will make the cursor larger)
Added a subtle particle effect when damaging enemies

Changes
All microtransactions have been removed. Any extra Bukkits that players have will be automatically converted to Chips upon login with a message that shows the amount
The VIP and FAN packages are being combined in to a VIP DLC Pack that will be available soon
Players that have purchased the old VIP and FAN packages still own them and will have the same benefits of those who purchase the new DLC Pack. No extra purchase necessary

Weapon sprees can now be stacked, removing the need to be killed before you can obtain another one (Sword Spree, Sniper Spree, Sprinkler Party, etc.)
The Catacomb map now has 2D lighting and no longer has a black vignette around the camera screen
The Paintbow weapon will now fire shots at max range 100% of the time instead of ending at your mouse cursor

Updated artwork and colors across the entire game
Some item requirements and Item prices have been adjusted
Some in-game tips have been updated and new ones have been added
Some Daily Challenges have been modified
The Sprinkler and Paintbow weapons have been added to the Twin Isles map
The Sword weapon now has a short cooldown if it is used before fully charging it
The Sniper weapon now has a short cooldown if it is used before fully charging it
The camera zoom feature on all maps has been disabled and replaced with an option to follow your mouse cursor
Non-VIP players can now stack Chip Boosts up to 3 max
VIP players will now gain 3 Chip Boosts per day, up to 9 max
Consecutive daily login rewards have been updated:
Day 1: 700 chips
Day 2: 1,000 chips
Day 3: 1 chip boost
Day 4: 1,300 chips
Day 5: 1,600 chips
Day 6: 1 chip boost
Day 7: 5,000 chips and 1 chip boost
The mouse cursor is now locked to the game window when focused

notes.title: Transitioning from Free to Paid
notes.content:
Greetings Chipsters!

We have some important news to share regarding Paint Chips. We've taken quite a long hiatus on this project and have recently returned to continue development. With a lot of internal discussion we've decided to transition to a paid model starting October 1st, 2023. The game will cost $14.99.

Why the change?
The biggest problem with our game is the lack of players online. The original idea of releasing the game for free was to allow anyone to download and try it out. Being a game you don't have to pay for also seems to include it being a game you don't have to care about.

According to our data from release up to the date of this post, only about 10% of players continued playing past their third match (roughly 10 minutes of playtime), and only about 5% continued past their tenth match (~30 minutes). That means 90% of players who tried the game have played it for less than 10 minutes.

With such a small community, the free version is not holding up as well as we would like. We feel that if players purchase the game, maybe they'll invest a little more time in to it before deciding to put it away or get a refund. Of course we could be wrong, but we're going to give the paid version a chance.

We want to continue adding new features, improve gameplay and make the game into something we're proud of. We love this game and want everyone who plays it to enjoy their time with it.

What does this mean for you?
Current Owners: If you already own Paint Chips, congratulations! You're all set and can continue enjoying the game without any additional cost.

Future Access: For those who haven't yet downloaded the game, starting on October 1st, a one-time purchase will be required for new players. If you add the game to your Steam library before the transition date, you will own the game for free!

What happens to the in-game microtransactions?
They're gone!

Bukkits will no longer be available for purchase. We're planning to convert the VIP and FAN packages to paid DLC. If you've already purchased one or both of these, you will still own them in-game.

Any Bukkits in your possession will be automatically converted to Chips for you. There's no need to worry about purchasing any items using your remaining Bukkits as they will be converted to the appropriate Chip value for the items in the shop.

After the transition:
We have a large update planned to be released very soon after the change from free to paid. We expect to be ready to release it on the same day. It will include new medals, a new co-op gametype and some new features. It will also include many improvements to existing systems. We also plan on opening the EU server once again!

If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us on Discord.

We want to express our sincere thanks for your ongoing support. Your passion drives us to create an even better experience. Thank you for being a part of Paint Chips. Together, we'll continue to make this game amazing!

<3
The PhatRobit Team

notes.title: Minor Patch - Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
I've been putting off controller support for some time, so have decided to release what I have to help out players that like to play on Steam Deck. Also for Steam Deck / Linux users, I've fixed the 'Quit' buttons so it actually closes the game now instead of freezing up. For whatever reason, Unity doesn't like to close on Linux machines using the regular method of quitting the application, so I had to add a workaround.

There are also a few small additions, such as a small effect on your feet if you're currently standing in friendly paint. There may be some other small things I'm forgetting, but that's all for now!

Thanks for playing our game, have fun!

notes.title: Update v1.7.0
notes.content:
Hello there!

In this update, we have a few quality of life improvements as well as some changes to gametypes. We've brought back Swipers and combined a few other gametypes into each other, reducing the total number of gametypes while retaining similar gameplay for them.

Friends List / Social Updates
There's now an in-game friends list (separate from your Steam friends) and a few new social options for other players around you, such as being able to ignore or report them. You can now also view the stats for other players.

To add a friend, you can send a request to them either by clicking on their character and selecting the 'Friend' button, or by clicking on their name in the new Social list and selecting that same 'Friend' button. This will send a friend request to them and you will become friends if they accept! If you already have a friend request from the player you send your own request to, you will automatically become friends.

Unfriending someone is a similar process, minus the request part. Just click on a user that's your friend or from your friend list, and click 'Unfriend'. This will remove them as your friend and will also remove you from their friend list.

Ignoring someone can be useful if you don't want to see any chat messages from them or emotes. To ignore someone, simply click on their character or button in the social list and select 'Ignore'. If for whatever reason you want to hear what they have to say again, you can 'Unignore' them the same way.

Reporting players is fairly simple as well. Just select 'Report' from the player menu and choose whichever reason(s) you are reporting them for. Hit the 'Submit' button and a report will be sent over to use for review. Please note that we will review each reported player manually and no action will be taken unless we deem it necessary, This may become automated at some point later, but for now to reduce the number of false positives, it will be done directly by us.

FAN Package
We've also added another paid package we're calling the FAN package. This is pretty similar to the VIP package, but a little bit cheaper. It gives you access to more items and an additional Chip discount in the item shop! It's a one time purchase of $8.

More Stuff
We added a couple of new weapons and we're curious to see what you all think of them. They're now available in every map. Give them a try and let us know how you like (or don't like) them in our Discord server!

Here's the full list of changes for this update:


New Stuff

A new paid FAN package has been added with various bonuses (similar to the VIP package):
10% Chip discount on all items in the shop (stacks with the VIP 20% discount, totaling 30% if you own both)
Green colored chat text (if you don't own VIP)
FAN tag on nameplate
FAN tag next to chat text (if you don't own VIP)
6 FAN only items included with purchase
Unlocks additional FAN items for purchase in the item shop
We have added a friend feature, allowing players to add each other to their friends lists (this is separate from your Steam friends list)
When a friend's online status changes, it will be displayed in your chat box
A sound effect has been added that plays when a friend comes online (can be disabled in the settings)
The Social button in the upper right corner of the Social lobby has been updated with some new features:

Friends tab - Displays all of your in-game friends (not Steam friends)
Pending - Displays a list of all the players that want to be your friend
Social - Displays a list of all the players that are in the Social lobby area with you
A new popup list has been added when selecting other players with some new options:

Always displays the selected player's nickname and level
Invite - Send an invitation to the player to join your group
Stats - View the stats for that player
Friend - Send a friend request to the player (when not your friend)
UnFriend - Remove the player from your friend list (when friends)
Ignore - Mutes all text and emotes from that player for your client (if not ignored)
UnIgnore - Allows you to see text and emotes from that player for your client (if ignored)
Report - Opens a dialogue allowing you to send us a report about a player that's causing trouble
The new popup list can also be opened when clicking on player nameplates in most areas of the game
Server list buttons now display a population value that indicates how many players are online
Added a new weapon: Sprinkler - A low damage short range paint focused sprayer
Added a new weapon: Paintbow - A fast low damage medium range weapon

notes.title: Update v1.6.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Apologies for the delay on this update, but it's here now! We're happy to bring you a new limited-time map for the Autumn season, Fall Manor! We've also added some new items, some themed for 'Back to School', but have not quite finished everything yet. Please be patient as we work to add the rest of the planned items for this season!

The most notable thing in this update is probably the new Bug Report feature! You can now send in bug reports directly from the game. This will make it easier on you and on us when coming across any issues. All you need to do is click on the red Bug Report button in the Social Lobby area, located at the top right corner of the screen (next to the VIP button). It will open a panel where you can type in a description of the issue you are facing and submit it to us for review.

We would like to let you know that this new form is only for bugs and not for reporting players. If you try to report a player using the Bug Report form, it will more than likely just be ignored. We will have a proper Player Report option in the future!

One last thing - We're opening two more servers! There will now be a server running in Asia and one in Europe along with the North America server. These new servers are temporary for the moment, but will hopefully become permanent. They will remain online for at least one or two months.

When playing on a different server, all of your progress (except Leaderboard status) will carry over with you on whichever server you select, so you don't need to worry about starting over. Your Leaderboard rank will not carry over between servers however, so you will have a different Leaderboard rank depending on which server you're playing on. The Daily Challenges will now be synced across servers as well. We hope that by having these additional servers that it will lower the latency for users in those areas to make the game more enjoyable!

Hello everyone! We're happy to bring you another update to Paint Chips.

The main highlight of this update are new Gametypes! You can now vote on a random selection of them in Quick Play to mix things up a bit, or go in to custom matches and select your favorite. In total there are now 9 gametypes to choose from! We plan on adding many more, but this is what we were able to complete since the previous update. We hope you all enjoy trying them out and can't wait to hear your thoughts on them.

We have also created a new map! Will you be able to find your way through the Catacombs? Watch out for spikes!

Another nice change is happening to the chat! The super ugly gigantic chat messages in the social lobby are no more, and in its place comes a nice little chat box. This box will now be available in most areas of the game (social, lobby, match), and messages will now be stored across each area for your reading pleasure. Up to 50 messages will be saved, and it is now possible to scroll through them all to see what you've missed! There are a few other minor additions to chat which you can read about below.

We want to express our deepest thanks to everyone playing our game! It's been a lot of fun working on this project and we're always trying to make improvements to increase your enjoyment of it. We try to listen to everyone's suggestions and implement everything that is in alignment with our final vision of the game! We hope to continue improving and making it the most enjoyable experience possible for every player out there. If you haven't already, please consider joining us on Discord where you can talk directly to the developers, make suggestions, report issues, and chat with players outside of the game.

notes.content:
A new month, a new event! This update brings the Wedding event for July, which contains a bunch of new items and some decoration.

We also hope to have improved latency issues for all players, allowing you to be more accurate with your shots against enemy targets. One downside to this is that you may see someone's shot miss you, but you end up getting hurt or dying anyway. That's just a compromise that had to be made to improve the overall experience. If you'd like more technical details about the weapon netcode, feel free to chat with us in our Discord server!

Unfortunately we weren't able to finish all of our planned features for this update, but we should hopefully be able to get them done within a few weeks. You can look forward to new game modes, outfit storage, customizable key bindings, and possibly more later this month!

notes.content:

Along with a few minor adjustments, there are now 97 new Steam Achievements for everyone to unlock. There would be more, but Steam doesn't want us to go beyond 100 yet, so we must wait a bit. We're still working on the artwork for the majority of the achievements, but they will be updated as we get them done.

There's also a new leaderboard feature! The leaderboard can be viewed in the Social Lobby area and will display the top 10 players each week. You can also see your own rank and placement, even if you aren't in the top 10. The leaderboard will be reset every week on Sunday at 12AM PST, and the results will be posted in our Discord server.

Here's the list of everything that's been updated:


New Stuff

There's now a player leaderboard that can be viewed in the Social Lobby which is reset on a weekly basis every Sunday
Added 97 Steam Achievements for players to unlock
Quick Play matches will now attempt to automatically switch hosts to the player with the lowest average latency
Muted players will now get a local notification when attempting to text-chat indicating that they are unable to

Added more new Daily Challenges

notes.title: Summer Update v1.2.0
notes.content:
Summer is upon us, and with it comes an update to Paint Chips!

For a limited time from June 1st to July 31st there are 31 new Summer-themed items to obtain in the item shop! After purchase with either Chips or Bukkits, the items are yours to keep and wear whenever you please. There is also a new map that will only be playable during the Summer event.

We hope you all enjoy the event!

Of course there are many other new, updated and fixed things in this update, which are as follows:


New Stuff

Items in the item shop will now have a "New" tag on them when there are items you haven't clicked on, making it easier to see what's new in the future
Added a "Rules" button on the Title menu so you can look at the rules whenever you like
Added a small "loading" icon when loading in to a match
Medals have been added, which are extra things you can earn during matches as a small bonus for playing well:

Double Chip - Get two consecutive kills within 4 seconds of one another
Triple Chip - Get three consecutive kills within 4 seconds of one another
Quad Chip - Get four consecutive kills within 4 seconds of one another
Ultra Chip - Get five (or more) consecutive kills within 4 seconds of one another
Chipping Spree - Get 5 kills without dying
Chipping Frenzy - Get 10 kills without dying
Chipping Riot - Get 15 kills without dying
Rocket Spree - Get 5 Rocket Launcher kills without dying
Shotgun Spree - Get 5 Shotgun kills without dying
Sniper Spree - Get 5 Sniper kills without dying
Sword Spree - Get 5 Sword kills without dying
Chipjoy - Kill someone who is on a Chipping Spree
Assist - Earned when a target you dealt 50% or more damage to is killed by someone else
Revenge - Your next kill is against the player or bot that killed you last
Avenger - Kill a target that has recently killed one of your team mates
First Chip - Get the first kill of the match
Unchippable - Complete a match with 15+ kills and 0 deaths

New challenges have been added for earning Medals
You can now see the paint value on other players
Added 31 new Summer-themed items
Added a new Summer-themed map
Added a sound effect for charging up the Sniper weapon
Added a "free" icon tag to the Chip Boost button if you have a free VIP boost available
The Daily Challenges will now be posted to our Discord server each day
The match lobby UI has been updated to better indicate that you're in a lobby for both Quick Play and Custom Games
A dialogue message will now appear if you attempt to enter Quick Play or a Custom Game when you are not the group leader
A dialogue message will now appear if you attempt to enter Quick Play or a Custom Game while the server is shutting down
There is now an optional Practice Match option for new players that puts them in a private battle with 3 other bots
Added two new emotes
A new Shotgun weapon has been added to all maps
A new Sword weapon has been added to all maps
Added some new Daily Challenges for the new Shotgun weapon
Added some new Daily Challenges for the new Sword weapon

Changes

Weapon icons and pickups have been updated
A bunch of words were removed from the language filter
The language filter now replaces all censored words with the word "CHIP" instead of asterisks
The size of paint splats that the Sniper weapon leaves behind has been reduced
The charge rate of the Sniper weapon is now on a slight curve instead of linear (the charge length remains the same)
Blaster paint splats have been slightly increased in size
Rocket Launcher now paints the ground near you when fired
Increased the shot cooldown on Rocket Launcher to 1 sec (previously 0.65 sec)
Increased the length of time that player-dropped weapons stay on the ground by 5 seconds
Made adjustments to Daily Challenge descriptions
Added a short cooldown for the "I'm Stuck" button in the Social Lobby
Added a sprite to the Bomb to make them more visible on bright backgrounds
Adjustments were made to a few Daily Challenge rewards:

Matchmaker reward is now 1500 Chips (decrease)
Win some, Lose some reward is now 3000 Chips (decrease)
Too Many Pizza reward is now 6500 Chips (decrease)
Blast from the Past reward is now 2500 Chips (increase)
Rack em up reward is now 5500 Chips (increase)

The Development server will no longer be shown in the list of servers
Group members are now randomized when selecting teams, so larger groups (5+) will no longer split the same player to the other team every time
Some changes have been made to hitscan weapons (Sniper / Shotgun) in an attempt to reduce lag while using them

Fixes

Emotes will no longer be triggered while typing in chat
Fixed a minor issue with the Custom Game start button
Fixed an issue that caused players to get stuck on the "Finding Match" dialogue window
Fixed an unpaintable area on the Wonderland map
Fixed an issue that prevented you from firing your weapon after picking up a new one
Fixed an issue that allowed players to pick up weapons after dying
Bombs should no longer clip through walls
Fixed an issue that sometimes prevented Bombs from exploding

notes.title: Public Beta 3 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Greetings Chipsters!

We don't have as many changes due to it only being a week since the previous test, but we did get some things done.

The largest change is to how player data is saved. Previously, player save data was saved to the server. It worked fine, but the issue is that players would not be able to carry over their save data if they wanted to switch servers. We made changes so that player data is now saved to a database which can be accessed by any server, thus allowing players to hop between servers while retaining their progress. This change has reset everyone's progress in the beta, but all progress will be reset again on May 4th once the game is fully released, so it isn't anything to worry about.

Here's a list of what's changed over the past week:


New Stuff

Player save data is now stored in a database instead of the server
Team colors can now be selected by the host in custom games
Explosions (bombs / rockets) now check line of sight on impact, so you can avoid damage by hiding behind things
Added some new daily challenges for specific weapon kills (blaster, sniper, rockets, bombs)
A short description has been added to the beginning of the match describing the main goal of the game type

Changes

Collision has been added to the Sniper weapon, so it can no longer shoot through obstacles
Rockets are now synced over the network better
Objects and effects have been added to the Wonderland map
Crosshairs have been updated with a dark outline to make it easier to keep track of in bright areas of the screen

Fixes

Fixed a bug causing you to join multiple matches at the same time (thanks mystrert!)



If you run in to any issues, please let us know on our Discord server. This test will run until Monday, April 19th at 12AM PST.

Have fun!

notes.title: Public Beta 2 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
We're just about to run our second open beta test, starting tomorrow! There have been a bunch of changes, additions and fixes that we made between the previous test last month and this one. Here's a list of most of the things we worked on:


New Additions

Added a daily challenge system that award extra chips when challenges are completed, resetting once per day
The total paint and kill scores per team are now displayed on the results screen
You can now go back to the score list after your rewards have finished being displayed
Added a spawn point system, reducing the ability to "spawn camp"
Added our PhatRobit splash screen on startup, which can be skipped by clicking anywhere
Added a Custom Game browser, making it easier to host and join custom games
It is now possible to use text-chat with your group in the main menu
A small icon is now displayed on group members that are in the customization window
Added notifications for when group members join, leave or are invited
Text notifications for group members are now a unique color
Group invitations now have a timeout
A new weapon has been added: Rocket Launcher
A new weapon has been added: Sniper
Added lobby voting, allowing players to choose between a few team colors and map choices before a match begins in Quick Play
Added a short invulnerability shield that's applied to players and bots when respawning from death
Added a new map: Spacey Space
Added a new map: Wonderland
Added a new map: Castle Keep
Added 14 new pets

Changes

Made some small changes to the settings panel
Anyone in your group now has the ability to invite their friends, not just the group leader
In matches that aren't full (less than 8 players), players that aren't grouped are now put on different teams
If a player joins a quick play lobby while the timer is below 10 seconds, 5 seconds will be added to the timer
Made adjustments to wing items so they are more visible
Hair color can now be customized, but it will still swap to your team color during a match

Fixes

Fixed an issue that caused group members to sometimes be displayed incorrectly in the menu
Group nameplates should now update properly when a member changes their name
Fixed some text wrapping issues
Fixed an issue that caused bombs to sometimes display a bot killing you instead of the player that threw the bomb
Fixed some areas where players could get stuck on the Park Island map



Please keep in mind that the game is still a work-in-progress and there is still more work to be done before release.

If you aren't sure how to participate in the beta tests, you can find all the info you need over on our Discord server.

If you have any suggestions or issues with the game while playing during the beta tests, please let us know by posting in the Steam discussion board or by joining our Discord server. We hope you enjoy playing the game!
